RCM Strategy.Consequence: Thermal stress progresses to derating/trip and possible secondary power-stage damage.
RCM Strategy.Rationale: Use on-condition/predictive intervention because degradation is measurable before functional failure and avoided generation loss exceeds planned intervention cost.

RCM Strategy.Consequence: Thermal derating/trip and accelerated component ageing.
RCM Strategy.Rationale: On-condition replacement is preferable to calendar-only replacement because fan electrical/thermal response provides advance warning and duty varies by site.

RCM Strategy.Detection_Method: DGA + moisture + winding/oil temperature + protection history
RCM Strategy.Consequence: Major outage, fire/safety exposure and long-duration replacement risk.
RCM Strategy.Rationale: Severe consequence requires governed diagnostics even when failure probability is low; DGA/moisture/thermal evidence supports on-condition escalation.

RCM Strategy.Detection_Method: Motor current signature + position error + duty cycle
RCM Strategy.Consequence: Persistent mis-tracking, row-level generation loss and possible mechanical damage.
RCM Strategy.Rationale: Condition-based inspection is justified because wear manifests in current/position signatures and failure consequence is primarily recoverable energy loss.

RCM Strategy.Consequence: Incorrect expected-generation baseline, PR/loss diagnosis and forecasting.
RCM Strategy.Rationale: Because drift can remain hidden, scheduled calibration/failure-finding is required; cross-reference checks provide earlier condition verification.

RCM Strategy.Detection_Method: Operation timing + trip-coil current + functional test
RCM Strategy.Consequence: Safety exposure, protection failure and extended plant outage.
RCM Strategy.Maintenance_Strategy: Failure-finding + Scheduled functional test + Condition monitoring
RCM Strategy.Rationale: Protective function may be hidden until demanded; periodic proof/functional testing is mandatory even when condition indicators are healthy.

RCM Strategy.Consequence: String loss, connector/fuse damage and elevated fire risk.
RCM Strategy.Rationale: Thermal and current evidence can identify degradation before open-circuit/fire consequence, enabling targeted inspection and replacement.

RCM Strategy.Detection_Method: Performance/loss attribution + IV curve + drone/thermal inspection
RCM Strategy.Consequence: Progressive energy underperformance; severe localized defects can create hotspot/fire risk.
RCM Strategy.Rationale: Intervention should be triggered by recoverable energy economics and condition evidence rather than fixed replacement/cleaning alone.

RCM Functions & Failures.Required_Function: Convert DC power to grid-compliant AC at required efficiency and availability while remaining within semiconductor thermal limits.
RCM Functions & Failures.Performance_Standard: Sustain commanded power without thermal derating/trip under valid operating envelope.
RCM Functions & Failures.Functional_Failure: Unable to sustain required AC conversion without thermal derating, abnormal harmonics or protective trip.

RCM Functions & Failures.Required_Function: Remove inverter heat so semiconductor and capacitor temperatures remain within design limits.
RCM Functions & Failures.Performance_Standard: Maintain governed cooling effectiveness across operating load and ambient-temperature range.
RCM Functions & Failures.Functional_Failure: Cooling system cannot maintain heat-sink/internal temperature below governed thermal limit.

RCM Functions & Failures.Required_Function: Transform and transfer power safely while maintaining dielectric integrity and protection coordination.
RCM Functions & Failures.Performance_Standard: Maintain insulation condition and temperatures within OEM/protection limits with no abnormal gas/moisture indicators.
RCM Functions & Failures.Functional_Failure: Insulation system can no longer provide required dielectric withstand or thermal margin.

RCM Functions & Failures.Required_Function: Position the tracker row to commanded angle accurately and safely throughout the solar day and stow events.
RCM Functions & Failures.Performance_Standard: Maintain position error within governed tolerance without abnormal drive current/torque.
RCM Functions & Failures.Functional_Failure: Tracker cannot reach/hold commanded angle within tolerance or requires abnormal drive effort.

RCM Functions & Failures.Required_Function: Measure solar resource accurately enough to support performance assessment, forecasting and loss attribution.
RCM Functions & Failures.Performance_Standard: Maintain irradiance measurement within governed calibration/quality tolerance.
RCM Functions & Failures.Functional_Failure: Sensor output drifts outside acceptable accuracy without an obvious hard failure.

RCM Functions & Failures.Required_Function: Interrupt fault current and isolate equipment within protection clearing time when demanded.
RCM Functions & Failures.Performance_Standard: Operate within governed timing/trip-coil/mechanical limits on every demand.
RCM Functions & Failures.Functional_Failure: Breaker fails to open/close or operates outside required clearing/mechanical performance.

RCM Functions & Failures.Required_Function: Combine and protect string currents with low-resistance, thermally stable electrical connections.
RCM Functions & Failures.Performance_Standard: Maintain terminal/fuse temperatures and string-current balance within governed limits.
RCM Functions & Failures.Functional_Failure: Connection/protection path develops abnormal resistance, heating or current imbalance.

RCM Functions & Failures.Required_Function: Convert incident irradiance to DC energy at expected yield without unsafe localized defects.
RCM Functions & Failures.Performance_Standard: Maintain weather-adjusted module/string output within governed performance and safety thresholds.
RCM Functions & Failures.Functional_Failure: Module/string output remains below expected level or localized defect creates unsafe thermal behavior.

RCM Decision Logic.Decision_Basis: Use on-condition/predictive intervention because degradation is measurable before functional failure and avoided generation loss exceeds planned intervention cost.
RCM Decision Logic.Secondary_RCM_Policy: Scheduled restoration/replacement after confirmed threshold breach
RCM Decision Logic.Fallback_Policy: Engineering redesign or power-stage replacement if degradation cannot be controlled economically
RCM Decision Logic.Decision_Path_Summary: Detectable + trended + feasible + economic → on-condition/predictive task.

RCM Decision Logic.Decision_Basis: On-condition replacement is preferable to calendar-only replacement because fan electrical/thermal response provides advance warning and duty varies by site.
RCM Decision Logic.Secondary_RCM_Policy: Scheduled replacement where condition monitoring is unavailable or site duty is severe
RCM Decision Logic.Fallback_Policy: Cooling-system redesign only for persistent common-cause recurrence
RCM Decision Logic.Design_Change_Required: No — unless common-cause recurrence is confirmed
RCM Decision Logic.Decision_Path_Summary: Detectable + trended → on-condition replacement; calendar replacement is secondary.

RCM Decision Logic.Decision_Basis: Severe consequence requires governed diagnostics even when failure probability is low; DGA/moisture/thermal evidence supports on-condition escalation.
RCM Decision Logic.Fallback_Policy: Major repair/replacement or engineering modification if dielectric risk remains unacceptable
RCM Decision Logic.Decision_Path_Summary: High consequence + detectable condition → diagnostic/on-condition policy with scheduled verification.

RCM Decision Logic.Decision_Basis: Condition-based inspection is justified because wear manifests in current/position signatures and failure consequence is primarily recoverable energy loss.
RCM Decision Logic.Secondary_RCM_Policy: Scheduled restoration/replacement after confirmed wear threshold
RCM Decision Logic.Fallback_Policy: Mechanical redesign/alignment correction if recurrence indicates systemic cause
RCM Decision Logic.Decision_Path_Summary: Detectable mechanical wear + economic recoverability → on-condition task.

RCM Decision Logic.Decision_Basis: Because drift can remain hidden, scheduled calibration/failure-finding is required; cross-reference checks provide earlier condition verification.
RCM Decision Logic.Fallback_Policy: Sensor replacement or measurement-system redesign when calibration cannot restore accuracy
RCM Decision Logic.Design_Change_Required: No — unless repeated drift is systemic
RCM Decision Logic.Decision_Path_Summary: Hidden information failure → periodic calibration/failure-finding remains mandatory.

RCM Decision Logic.Selected_Failure_Management_Policy: Failure-finding + Scheduled functional test + Condition monitoring
RCM Decision Logic.Decision_Basis: Protective function may be hidden until demanded; periodic proof/functional testing is mandatory even when condition indicators are healthy.
RCM Decision Logic.Fallback_Policy: Replace or redesign protection/switching arrangement if proof testing exposes unacceptable latent risk
RCM Decision Logic.Decision_Path_Summary: Hidden protective function → failure-finding/proof testing regardless of healthy condition indicators.

RCM Decision Logic.Decision_Basis: Thermal and current evidence can identify degradation before open-circuit/fire consequence, enabling targeted inspection and replacement.
RCM Decision Logic.Secondary_RCM_Policy: Scheduled restoration/replacement after confirmed thermal/electrical defect
RCM Decision Logic.Fallback_Policy: Connector/fuse/termination redesign if recurring common-cause overheating is confirmed
RCM Decision Logic.Decision_Path_Summary: Detectable thermal/current evidence → targeted on-condition intervention.

RCM Decision Logic.Decision_Basis: Intervention should be triggered by recoverable energy economics and condition evidence rather than fixed replacement/cleaning alone.
RCM Decision Logic.Secondary_RCM_Policy: Scheduled cleaning/restoration when economic threshold is reached
RCM Decision Logic.Fallback_Policy: No scheduled restoration until consequence/economic threshold; redesign only for systemic defect pattern
RCM Decision Logic.Design_Change_Required: No — unless systemic defect pattern is confirmed
RCM Decision Logic.Decision_Path_Summary: Visible performance loss + economic threshold → performance-based/on-condition intervention.

RCM Task Triggers.Task_Definition: Trend heat-sink/IGBT temperature, conversion efficiency and current/harmonic signatures; inspect cooling path and power stage when trigger persists.
RCM Task Triggers.Trigger_Or_Threshold: Sustained thermal deviation from governed peer/baseline plus corroborating electrical anomaly, or governed RUL/action threshold.
RCM Task Triggers.Base_Interval: Continuous monitoring; engineer review on trigger

RCM Task Triggers.Task_Definition: Inspect fan/filter/cooling path and replace fan when electrical signature and cooling effectiveness degrade together.
RCM Task Triggers.Trigger_Or_Threshold: Fan current/rotation anomaly corroborated by abnormal heat-sink temperature rise under comparable load and ambient conditions.
RCM Task Triggers.Base_Interval: Continuous telemetry; physical inspection on trigger

RCM Task Triggers.Task_Definition: Review DGA/moisture/thermal trends, perform oil/insulation diagnostics and escalate to specialist testing when trigger criteria are met.
RCM Task Triggers.Trigger_Or_Threshold: Abnormal governed DGA/moisture pattern, thermal trend or protection evidence beyond asset-specific reference limits.
RCM Task Triggers.Base_Interval: Periodic laboratory/diagnostic schedule plus event-based escalation
RCM Task Triggers.Likely_Parts: Diagnostic consumables; repair/retrofit kit per diagnosis
RCM Task Triggers.Isolation_Or_Outage: Planned HV isolation if intrusive test/repair required

RCM Task Triggers.Task_Definition: Inspect motor/gearbox, lubrication, linkage and position feedback when position error and motor-current signature corroborate.
RCM Task Triggers.Trigger_Or_Threshold: Persistent commanded-versus-actual position error with abnormal motor current/torque under comparable wind/stow conditions.
RCM Task Triggers.Base_Interval: Continuous controller monitoring; inspection on trigger

RCM Task Triggers.Task_Definition: Cross-check against redundant/reference source, clean sensor and perform calibration/replace when drift persists.
RCM Task Triggers.Trigger_Or_Threshold: Persistent reference deviation beyond governed tolerance or due calibration date.
RCM Task Triggers.Base_Interval: Monthly data-quality verification; annual calibration baseline, climate adjusted

RCM Task Triggers.Selected_Policy: Failure-finding + Scheduled functional test + Condition monitoring
RCM Task Triggers.Task_Definition: Perform governed breaker timing/trip-coil/mechanism test and inspect/maintain mechanism based on test result.
RCM Task Triggers.Trigger_Or_Threshold: Scheduled proof-test due, abnormal operation timing/trip-coil signature, or protection event.
RCM Task Triggers.Base_Interval: Planned functional-test interval per OEM/site criticality plus event-based test

RCM Task Triggers.Task_Definition: Thermographic inspection, torque/connection verification and fuse/terminal replacement when corroborated anomaly is confirmed.
RCM Task Triggers.Trigger_Or_Threshold: Hot connection/fuse relative to peer baseline plus corroborating string-current imbalance or protection evidence.
RCM Task Triggers.Base_Interval: Continuous string monitoring where available; periodic thermal inspection

RCM Task Triggers.Task_Definition: Inspect/clean/test affected block; use IV/thermal evidence to distinguish soiling from module/diode/connector degradation before replacement.
RCM Task Triggers.Trigger_Or_Threshold: Weather-adjusted recoverable loss exceeds governed economic threshold or condition inspection confirms actionable defect.
RCM Task Triggers.Base_Interval: Performance monitoring continuous; inspection/cleaning frequency climate/economics adjusted
RCM Task Triggers.Likely_Parts: Cleaning resources / module or connector kit as confirmed

RCM Climate Applicability.Climate_Stressors: Hot/dry and high-ambient sites accelerate thermal cycling; baseline and review threshold should be site-temperature normalized.
RCM Climate Applicability.RCM_Adjustment_Rule: Increase thermal-trend scrutiny and shorten engineering review window during high-ambient periods.
RCM Climate Applicability.Rule_Type: Applicability adjustment; does not overwrite OEM limits

RCM Climate Applicability.Climate_Stressors: Hot/dry and dusty sites increase fan duty and filter loading.
RCM Climate Applicability.RCM_Adjustment_Rule: Shorten inspection/cleaning interval when dust loading or ambient temperature is persistently high.
RCM Climate Applicability.Rule_Type: Applicability adjustment; does not overwrite OEM limits

RCM Climate Applicability.Climate_Stressors: Hot/humid and flood-prone conditions increase moisture and insulation stress.
RCM Climate Applicability.RCM_Adjustment_Rule: Increase moisture ingress checks after flooding/high humidity events and adjust thermal interpretation for ambient/loading.
RCM Climate Applicability.Rule_Type: Applicability adjustment; does not overwrite OEM limits

RCM Climate Applicability.Climate_Stressors: Dust, high wind and frequent stow cycles accelerate tracker mechanical wear.
RCM Climate Applicability.RCM_Adjustment_Rule: Increase post-storm inspection and duty-cycle review; shorten lubrication review in dusty/high-cycle sites.
RCM Climate Applicability.Rule_Type: Applicability adjustment; does not overwrite OEM limits

RCM Climate Applicability.Climate_Stressors: Soiling, dust, humidity and condensation affect sensor response and cleaning frequency.
RCM Climate Applicability.RCM_Adjustment_Rule: Increase cleaning/reference-check frequency in dusty or humid seasons.
RCM Climate Applicability.Rule_Type: Applicability adjustment; does not overwrite OEM limits

RCM Climate Applicability.Climate_Stressors: Humidity, dust, corrosion and flood exposure can degrade mechanisms and insulation.
RCM Climate Applicability.RCM_Adjustment_Rule: Add post-flood/post-dust-event inspection and corrosion/moisture checks where applicable.
RCM Climate Applicability.Rule_Type: Applicability adjustment; does not overwrite OEM limits

RCM Climate Applicability.Climate_Stressors: High ambient, humidity/corrosion and thermal cycling increase connection stress.
RCM Climate Applicability.RCM_Adjustment_Rule: Increase corrosion/thermal review in humid/coastal or high-temperature locations.
RCM Climate Applicability.Rule_Type: Applicability adjustment; does not overwrite OEM limits

RCM Climate Applicability.Climate_Stressors: Soiling, humidity, UV, thermal cycling, hail/wind and flooding affect degradation and inspection frequency.
RCM Climate Applicability.RCM_Adjustment_Rule: Adapt cleaning/inspection program to local climate stressor and seasonal economics rather than one fleet-wide interval.
RCM Climate Applicability.Rule_Type: Applicability adjustment; does not overwrite OEM limits
